(2) The scene shifts to the man holding a whole green apple, then using a wooden skewer to poke it through the core. He is in a brightly lit kitchen with wooden shelves in the background. (3) A close-up shows white granulated sugar and water being poured into a white enamel pot on a stove. (4) Red food coloring is dropped into the pot and stirred, turning the bubbling clear liquid into a vibrant red syrup. (5) The man uses a yellow handheld infrared thermometer to check the temperature of the boiling red sugar. (6) He tests the syrup consistency by dipping a stick into cold water and feeling it with his fingers. (7) The green apple on the skewer is rotated inside the red syrup until fully coated and dripping. (8) In a bowl, the man mixes white sugar with brown cinnamon powder using a spoon. (9) He coats the sticky red apple with the cinnamon-sugar mixture, causing it to have a frosted appearance. (10) The man cuts the finished apple into slices on a wooden board and eats a piece, showing a highly satisfied expression.
